notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source for the tower itself is the Dunigan index (coordinates, register numbers, naming note). Two searches and several page reads turned up no build date, staffing, status or fire history. Mapcarta gives the community's position, not the tower's history. The Wikimedia Commons photo 'SR94 unused tower, Charlton County.JPG' has its camera about 13 km south of this tower's coordinates, so it is a different structure and is not used. The index elevation (137) is not used because the page does not state its unit. Status and access are unknown.
